description: Defines the WhiteListedOriginDomainsList class, which manages a whitelist of domain origins for web extensions, including parsing from a string, storing the list internally, and applying it to WebKit extensions.

classes.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList
classes.description: Manages a whitelist of domain origins, allowing parsing, storing, and applying whitelist data to WebKit extensions.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a whitelist string into a WhiteListedOriginDomainsList instance.

methods.name: AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the stored whitelist entries to a given WebKitWebExtension.
